title: Immutable vs Mutable
instructions: What happens if you try to call `.add()` on a list created with `listOf()`?

options.text: It works fine and adds the element
It adds the element at the end

explanation: Lists created with `listOf()` are immutable. They do not have an `.add()` method, so the Kotlin compiler will show an error before the program even runs. Use `mutableListOf()` if you need to add or remove elements.
